name: artcraft-automation
description: Third-party agent skill for the ArtCraft family of apps (LightCraft RAW developer, FilmCraft video editor, PhotoCraft image editor) — drives them through their command-line tools, JSON-lines control channels and MCP servers. Not the official ArtCraft repository.

displayDescription.en: Drives the ArtCraft suite (LightCraft / FilmCraft / PhotoCraft) via CLI, JSON control channel and MCP server. A third-party agent skill — not the official ArtCraft repository.
displayDescription.zh: 用 CLI、控制通道与 MCP 驱动 ArtCraft 套件，RAW 修图、视频剪辑、图像编辑都能 AI 代办。面向 ArtCraft 系列软件的第三方 agent skill，非 ArtCraft 官方仓库。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 先跑环境自检，然后帮我把 ~/Pictures/trip 里的 RAW 照片批量调色并导出 JPG
defaultInitPrompt.en: Run the environment check first, then batch-grade the RAW photos in ~/Pictures/trip and export JPGs.

quickPrompts.zh: 先跑环境自检，再帮我把 ~/Pictures/trip 里的 RAW 照片批量调色并导出 JPG
quickPrompts.en: Run the environment check first, then batch-grade the RAW photos in ~/Pictures/trip and export JPGs.

quickPrompts.zh: 驱动我正在用的 FilmCraft，通过控制通道截个图看看当前时间线状态
quickPrompts.en: Drive the FilmCraft I'm using right now — take a screenshot over the control channel to check the current timeline state.

quickPrompts.zh: 把 PhotoCraft 通过 MCP 接进 Claude，之后我可以用自然语言修图
quickPrompts.en: Wire PhotoCraft into Claude over MCP so I can retouch images with natural language from now on.
